What we do

Roofing for buildings that can't afford a leak

One crew for the whole life of a roof — install, inspect, maintain, repair, and replace. Every job starts with a call; scope and pricing are confirmed by phone.

Representative photo

Commercial Roofing

Flat and low-slope systems for offices, retail, and multi-tenant buildings — installed and serviced with minimal disruption below.
Representative photo

Brownstone Roofing

Roof work that respects historic New York brownstones — their cornices, parapets, and flat roof lines.
Representative photo

Repair & Emergency Repair

Leaks, seam failures, punctures, storm damage. Call anytime — active leaks get treated like the emergency they are.
Representative photo

Inspection & Preventive Maintenance

Scheduled inspections and maintenance that catch small problems — ponding, worn seams, clogged drains — before they become interior damage.
